warnings: Collectors have not run yet. Theme definitions are the initial watchlist, not observed conclusions.

weekly.title: The radar is ready for its first collection
weekly.summary: The initial taxonomy is visible below. Scores remain N/O until public evidence has been collected and classified.

themes.name: AI-native GTM
themes.definition: AI systems that perform or reshape sales, marketing, revenue operations, and customer acquisition work.

themes.name: Small & specialized models
themes.definition: Compact or task-specific models optimized for cost, latency, privacy, or a bounded workload.

themes.name: Operational ontology
themes.definition: A structured representation connecting enterprise entities, data, permissions, and actions for people and agents.

themes.name: Frontier inference infrastructure
themes.definition: Large-scale compute, networking, serving, memory, and power systems optimized for frontier-model inference.

themes.name: Specialized inference silicon
themes.definition: Purpose-built chips and architectures optimized for low-latency or high-throughput model inference.

themes.name: Agent harnesses
themes.definition: Control loops, context, memory, planning, and orchestration systems that turn models into reliable agents.

themes.name: Assurance infrastructure
themes.definition: Evaluation, security, observability, governance, provenance, and operational controls for AI systems.
